title: Cloud providers continue AI infrastructure spending
summary: Large cloud and platform companies continue to describe AI infrastructure as a priority area for capital expenditure.
rationale: Sustained capex supports the thesis causal chain from AI demand to infrastructure-linked earnings.

title: AI monetization remains uneven
summary: Some AI products still have uncertain monetization, which may challenge the durability of infrastructure spending.
rationale: Weak monetization evidence challenges the assumption that capex remains fundable over several years.

title: Policy support improves sentiment but earnings remain mixed
summary: Policy support has improved risk appetite, while earnings revisions have not yet turned broadly positive.
rationale: The evidence supports sentiment but is not enough to confirm the earnings leg of the thesis.

title: Reserve diversification remains relevant
summary: Central-bank reserve diversification remains a recurring support factor for gold allocation discussions.
rationale: Reserve diversification supports the long-term allocation case.

title: Large-cap technology valuations remain elevated
summary: Technology-heavy indexes continue to trade with elevated expectations relative to broad global equity benchmarks.
rationale: Elevated valuation supports monitoring valuation compression risk.

title: Rate expectations remain volatile
summary: Changing rate expectations continue to affect equity duration risk and dollar-sensitive assets.
rationale: Rate volatility supports keeping USD liquidity as an active review thesis.
